training_seed_policy: official run.py: Caltech config seed=4, Scene config seed=8; np=seed, random=seed+1, torch=seed+2; the five repetitions vary official data/mask seed, not model initialization
intermediate_kmeans: official random_state=None at original print cadence, consumes training numpy RNG; no labels or intermediate scores
A: zero missing view latent only; observed entries identical to B
B: official cross-view predictor output; concatenate latent views without scaling
E: replace every missing view latent with same trained encoder applied to full true feature; observed entries unchanged
s1: Fit K prototypes by KMeans on pooled observed view latents only with seed 20261027. q_k(z) proportional to (1+||z-center_k||^2)^(-1), normalize across prototypes; s1=-Jensen-Shannon(q(predicted missing view), q(observed view)); higher is more reliable
s2: KMeans on B concatenation with seeds 100..109 and same other settings. Hungarian align each partition to fixed B partition using cluster contingency only; s2=mean aligned assignment agreement per sample; higher is more reliable
completion_error: cosine distance between predicted and oracle missing-view latent; error never used in selection
oracle_selection: floor(number_missing/2) lowest score; ties broken by original sample index; each incomplete sample has exactly one missing view
random_selection: one shared equal-size subset per group for both scores; np.random.default_rng(SeedSequence([20261027, dataset_index, round(rate*1000), data_seed, 5198418])); persist indices
correlation_aggregation: Spearman per model/mask on missing samples; arithmetic mean over 5 seeds, also report all coefficients, p-values and ties; no pooling across runs
decision_scope: primary rate 0.5; same dataset AND same score must meet reliability criteria; at least one dataset must meet ceiling and reliability together to pass; report dataset-specific decisions
threshold_gap: When no dataset meets ceiling and some primary E-B is >=0.01, the supplied rules do not uniquely classify; explicitly report indeterminate, do not invent a new threshold
rate_0_7: auxiliary only; does not alter primary decision
labels: only final offline ACC/NMI/ARI; K fixed to published dataset class count, independent of loaded label values
